description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Packaging' that declares methods for obtaining package details for shipping products, used within a shipping/integration module.

classes.name: Packaging
classes.description: A Java interface providing method signatures for retrieving package details based on products and merchant store context.

methods.name: getBoxPackagesDetails
methods.description: Method to retrieve list of package details for products packed in boxes, based on merchant store info; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
methods.description: Method to retrieve list of package details for individual items, based on merchant store info; may throw ServiceException.
